review_decisions.statement: Recognize recovered PHR-002 AN ZAMI ZAMO as evidence that first-person AN usage exists, while explicitly rejecting it as sufficient evidence for a productive L03 declarative template or general AN+predicate order.
Keep SARU as WATCH lexical evidence for todos os dias / habitualidade only; do not equate SARU to usually and do not infer habitual/frequency grammar.
Keep SALI=precisar (WATCH) and DAYI=querer/intenção (CANDIDATE/PARTIAL) as lexical evidence only; modal syntax, complements, future and planning remain unresolved.
Keep TA=destino/propósito as CANDIDATE/PARTIAL lexical evidence only; position, scope, attachment and productivity remain unresolved.
Do not automatically inherit AN, EN, KE, NE, KUVAN, KU or any other prior-lesson functional token into L03 without direct scoped evidence or a separate approved gate.
Do not derive an L03 declarative by removing KE from a question, rearranging tokens, or applying analogy from L01/L02 without direct source-backed evidence.

governance_decisions.statement: Pattern source review is not pattern promotion, authoring, validation, runtime activation or curriculum slot assignment.
Infer no universal word order, declarative, interrogative, locative, modal, habitual, frequency, aspect, tense, future, planning or complement grammar from this review.
Preserve all FROZEN/WATCH/CANDIDATE/PARTIAL authority and certainty labels exactly as sourced.
Reference languages remain comparative only and numerology remains allocation/count governance only; neither selects HNK forms or syntax.
Keep I usually... as a curriculum target with HNK realization unresolved/null.
If approved, prepare a separate pattern-evidence classification gate; do not author OPI, QA or Structures with the same approval.
